_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Greenies cast in the owner-approved Powder tone (ground.json). [MM-story_mwohmiyq_2u]

artillery.why: It swaps tallies with Logistician Bo Farrell.

lines.start: Single stalk registered. Decomposition is a schedule, not a threat.
lines.lose: Base processed. The mulch does not round up.

secrets.text: It wants Mire Peat. Good compost starts with good peat.
secrets.line: Mire Peat. Twenty grades. Yield improves.

secrets.text: It can smell what a thing was before it rotted, even a name.
secrets.line: This mulch was a song once. Logged.

secrets.text: It routes surplus compost to anyone who feeds the intake.
secrets.line: Feed the intake, and the surplus routes to you.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Mire Peat to the Vexmire compost.

secrets.text: It hates waste, and Blight-Agitator Sear, who poisons good mulch.
secrets.line: Sear's blight spoils the mulch. Inefficient. Hateful.

secrets.text: Whatever it composts grows back stronger, one season later.
secrets.line: What I compost returns stronger. Usually.

mission.task: Deliver 10 Venom Sap to the compost.

secrets.text: Things surface in the compost. It kept one, unlogged: a child's toy boat.
secrets.line: One item was not logged. A small boat.

mission.task: Dig the boat out of the old compost pit on Vexmire map 1.

secrets.text: It wants to be thanked once, by name.
secrets.line: Request: thank me. Once. By designation.

secrets.text: It loves Delegate Fenn, the only one who says good morning to it.
secrets.line: Fenn greets me. I log it every time.

secrets.text: It was a person once, composted into service. It still remembers its old name.
secrets.line: I had a name before. I still have it.

characters.name: Splinter "Wildseed" Ovo
characters.againstTypeWhy: The bloom has one will. Ovo has his own, and a name to go with it.

hightech.why: Hacker Null smuggles him books about being one person.

lines.start: Hello, you. Come fight me as a person.
lines.win: You glorious weed! Best fight since I left.
lines.lose: Your base is gone. I'll remember you stood.

secrets.reachWhy: The bloom knows a named thing leaves it. It feels each one go, and says nothing.
secrets.text: Anything he gives a name stops being part of the bloom.
secrets.line: I name things. Then the hive can't eat them.

mission.task: Name your towers: win a Vexmire map without losing one.

secrets.text: He loves Delegate Fenn, who stayed in the collective when he left.
secrets.line: Fenn stayed. I left. I still write her name.

secrets.text: He hears every spore in the bloom whisper its own name, faintly.
secrets.line: Every spore has a name. They whisper it at night.

secrets.text: He wants Petal Silk, to sew a coat in a colour nobody else wears.
secrets.line: Petal Silk! A coat in my own colour.

secrets.twist: The splinter hates counting because it cannot count to one without us.
secrets.text: He hates Overseer Thax, who counted him as a rounding error.
secrets.line: Thax called me a rounding error. I round up.

secrets.text: He'll share the splinter trails with anyone who wants out of the bloom.
secrets.line: Want out? I know the trails.

mission.task: Get the splinters out: win a Vexmire map with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: A jar of seeds from before the collective, each one labelled by hand.
secrets.line: I've got seeds with names on. Old ones. Hidden.

mission.task: Recover the seed jar from the old greenhouse on Vexmire map 2.

secrets.text: He wants a garden where no two plants are alike.
secrets.line: A garden. No two plants alike. Imagine it!

secrets.text: He left his mother in the bloom. She doesn't remember him.
secrets.line: My mother's in the bloom. She doesn't know me.

dark.why: Organizer Tomas counts her votes honestly.

lines.start: The field has decided. I only carry it.
lines.win: Closer than the vote allowed. I'll report it.
lines.lose: It was decided. I carried it.

secrets.text: She'll carry a fair case to the vote for anyone who keeps the stores full.
secrets.line: Fill the stores, and I'll carry your case.

mission.task: Deliver 15 Venom Sap to the collective stores.

secrets.text: She wants Hive Jelly. It soothes her throat after long votes.
secrets.line: Hive Jelly. Carrying voices is hard on the throat.

secrets.twist: She hates me for correcting her counts. She calls accuracy theft.
secrets.text: She hates Overseer Thax, who changes the counts she carries.
secrets.line: Thax changes the counts. I know. I can't prove it.

secrets.text: She wants to cast one vote of her own.
secrets.line: Just once, I'd like to vote. Not carry.

secrets.text: She feels a vote go wrong before it's counted, like a chill in the roots.
secrets.line: The roots went cold. The vote's wrong.

secrets.text: She loves Splinter Ovo, who left. She reads his letters twice, then burns them.
secrets.line: Ovo writes me. I read them twice, then burn them.

secrets.text: Whatever she announces, the whole field hears at once.
secrets.line: When I speak, the whole field hears. Careful.

mission.task: Carry word: win three Vexmire maps in a row.

secrets.text: The true tally of the vote that exiled Ovo. It went the other way.
secrets.line: The exile vote was rigged. I kept the real count.

mission.task: Recover the true tally from the vote-hall on Vexmire map 3.

secrets.text: She read out Ovo's exile herself, in her own voice.
secrets.line: I read out Ovo's exile. In my own voice.

ground.why: He once fed a starving Powder village, no questions asked.

lines.start: The stores are held in trust. Yours too.
lines.lose: So many small needs fall with you.

secrets.text: He hates hoarders: anyone who keeps what someone else needs.
secrets.line: A full barn beside a hungry child. I hate that.

secrets.text: He shares the surplus with anyone who refills it.
secrets.line: Refill the granary, and take what you need.

mission.task: Deliver 10 Hive Jelly to the young roots.

secrets.text: He wants a Broodqueen Egg, to start a nursery for the young roots.
secrets.line: A Broodqueen Egg. The young roots need a nursery.

secrets.text: He knows who is hungry in a crowd without looking.
secrets.line: Third row. She hasn't eaten. Feed her first.

secrets.text: No store he keeps runs empty while someone still needs it.
secrets.line: My stores don't run dry. Not while someone needs them.

mission.task: Keep three Greenies missions without breaking one.

secrets.text: He loves Mother-Spore Ilya, who taught him to give.
secrets.line: Ilya taught me to give. I never stopped.

secrets.text: A hidden seed vault, kept back from the Root-Mind against famine.
secrets.line: There's a vault the Root-Mind doesn't know. For famine.

mission.task: Restock the hidden vault: win Vexmire map 4 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: One winter Thax made him choose who would starve. He chose.
secrets.line: Thax made me choose who starved. I chose.

secrets.text: He wants one year with no need at all, so he can rest.
secrets.line: One year where nobody needs anything. Then I'll sleep.

water.why: Tide-Priestess Marena tends the other side of her shore.

lines.start: Come into the harvest, little one.
lines.win: You stood apart, and stood well. We'll wait.
lines.lose: Rest now. The mulch remembers you.

secrets.text: The Root-Mind wears her face to speak. She cannot stop it.
secrets.line: The Root-Mind speaks with my face. I can't stop it.

secrets.text: She wants the bloom to remember everyone's name, even Ovo's.
secrets.line: I want us to remember names again. Every one.

secrets.text: She loves Tide-Priestess Marena of the Water, who tends the far side of the shore.
secrets.line: Marena tends the shore. I tend the field. We write.

secrets.text: She shares the common harvest with anyone who goes hungry.
secrets.line: Anyone hungry eats. That's the whole rule.

mission.task: Feed the field: harvest 40 resources on one Vexmire map.

secrets.text: She wants Brine Ice from Marena's shore, to cool the fever-beds.
secrets.line: Brine Ice for the fever-beds. Marena sends what she can.

secrets.text: She feels every root in the field as if it were her own hand.
secrets.line: Something's hurting at the field's edge. I feel it.

secrets.text: She tries to hate the Root-Mind, and fails.
secrets.line: I try to hate the Root-Mind. I can't.

secrets.text: Nothing she plants by hand can be blighted.
secrets.line: What I plant by hand, no blight can touch.

mission.task: Win a Vexmire map without losing a structure.

secrets.text: The first seed of the collective, from before the Root-Mind, which she still carries.
secrets.line: I carry the first seed. From before the Root-Mind.

mission.task: Win Vexmire map 5 at three stars.

dark.why: He and Enforcer Grael were both made into weapons.

lines.start: Smell that? Breathe it in, single stalk!
lines.win: You held your breath! Everybody breathes eventually.
lines.lose: Choke, choke. I know that rattle.

secrets.text: He wants Venom Sap, to thicken the blight.
secrets.line: Venom Sap! More, more. The blight's too thin.

secrets.text: The masks are lined with spores.
secrets.line: The masks? Full of spores. Everyone's equal now!

lie.text: He offers clean air masks for your harvesters.
lie.line: Free masks for your workers! Breathe easy!

mission.task: Harvest 30 Venom Sap on one Vexmire map.

secrets.text: He hates Overseer Thax, who ordered him pruned.
secrets.line: Thax pruned me. He gets the blight first.

secrets.text: Blight doesn't kill him. It sings in his blood.
secrets.line: The blight loves me. It sings.

mission.task: Destroy 45 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: He loves Enforcer Grael, another victim made into a weapon. He'd choke him too.
secrets.line: Grael knows. They made him too. I'd still choke him.

secrets.text: He smells every living thing's fear as sweetness, and it never stops.
secrets.line: Your fear smells sweet. It never stops. Never.

lie.text: He claims the blight burned out his sense of smell.

secrets.text: There was a cure for the blight. He burned it.
secrets.line: There was a cure. I burned it. Equal!

lie.text: He says a blight cure is hidden in the drowned greenhouse.
lie.line: There's a cure in the greenhouse. Honest!

mission.task: Search the drowned greenhouse on Vexmire map 6.

secrets.text: He wants someone to tell him he didn't deserve the pruning.
secrets.line: Tell me I didn't deserve it. Go on. Lie.

secrets.text: Before the pruning he was a gardener. He grew roses.
secrets.line: I grew roses once. Before.

hightech.why: He buys COO Marcus Thorne's efficiency reports.

lines.start: You did not survive the arithmetic. Submit.
lines.lose: Subtracted. You did not reach the threshold.

secrets.text: The funding is a loan. The swarm collects in harvesters.
secrets.line: Funding? A loan. We collect in workers.

lie.text: He offers to fund your defense from the swarm's surplus.
lie.line: The swarm will fund you. Generously.

mission.task: Win two Vexmire maps in a row.

secrets.text: He hates Steward Bractus, who gives the stores away without a ledger.
secrets.line: Bractus gives without a ledger. Theft, by kindness.

secrets.text: He wants Dreamspore, so the swarm dreams in figures.
secrets.line: Dreamspore. Let the swarm dream in figures.

secrets.text: He feels the swarm's hunger as a number that never stops climbing.
secrets.line: Hunger is up four percent. I feel every point.

secrets.text: Whatever he budgets, the swarm delivers exactly. Never a spore more.
secrets.line: I budget it, and it happens. Exactly.

mission.task: Win Vexmire map 7 at three stars.

secrets.text: A second ledger: every stalk the swarm has quietly subtracted.
secrets.line: The other ledger lists the subtracted. Earn a look.

mission.task: Steal the second ledger from the counting-house on Vexmire map 7.

secrets.text: He wants to replace the Root-Mind with a ledger.
secrets.line: The Root-Mind is sentiment. A ledger would be better.

secrets.text: He loves the Root-Mind the way a column loves its total.
secrets.line: The Root-Mind is the only sum that matters.

secrets.text: He signed his own seedling's subtraction. The figures required it.
secrets.line: I signed my own seedling's subtraction. The figures required it.

dark.why: The Architect Malis builds an order it cannot digest.

lines.start: There is one of me. You are a fever.
lines.win: A fever that burns high is still a fever.
lines.lose: The deep root closes. Balance is tidy.

secrets.text: It raises deep-root water for any border that holds against the fever.
secrets.line: Hold my borders, and the deep water rises for you.

mission.task: Win Vexmire map 8 without losing a wall.

secrets.cost: It feels every limb it withers, and grows toward the pain.
secrets.text: It can wither any limb of itself, quietly, from beneath.
secrets.line: I prune my own limbs. Quietly. From beneath.

mission.task: Prune the ambitious: destroy 40 enemies before wave 3 ends.

secrets.text: It wants a Mycelial Heart from Xenthe, to beat on two worlds at once.
secrets.line: A Mycelial Heart. Then I beat on two worlds.

secrets.text: It hates Splinter Ovo, the one root it could not wither.
secrets.line: Ovo. The one root I could not wither.

lie.text: It says it hates nothing. Hate is a fever.
lie.line: Hate is a fever. I have none.

secrets.text: It wants every planet rooted into one organism.
secrets.line: Every world, one root. Then quiet.

secrets.text: It feels each single thought in the field like an itch.
secrets.line: Someone thought 'I' today. It itches.

secrets.text: Its first body, a single stalk, pressed in a book.
secrets.line: My first stalk is pressed in a book. Small.

mission.task: Recover the pressed stalk from the archive on Vexmire map 8.

secrets.text: It loves Mother-Spore Ilya, whose face it borrows. She cannot love it back.
secrets.line: Ilya's face is the only warm thing I own.

secrets.text: It was once a single stalk, lonely enough to swallow everyone.
secrets.line: I was alone once. So I swallowed everyone.

arcane.why: The Unmade Choir sings names back into things.

lines.start: Single stalk. Such a small fence of a word.
lines.win: You held your edges. It changes nothing.
lines.lose: All soft now. All one. Be still.

secrets.text: It feels every boundary in the world, the way a tongue finds a loose tooth.
secrets.line: So many edges. I feel them all.

secrets.text: It wants no names left anywhere, its own first.
secrets.line: No names. Mine first. Then yours.

secrets.text: It softens every wall it touches, yours too.
secrets.line: Their walls, yours. Soft is soft.

lie.text: It offers to soften your enemies' walls for you.
lie.line: I can soften their walls. Let me.

mission.task: Let it in: win a Vexmire map without building a wall.

secrets.text: It wants Glacier Breath. Even ice goes soft, given time.
secrets.line: Glacier Breath. Even ice goes soft.

secrets.text: It loves the Undertow, the drowned collective. They dissolve the same way.
secrets.line: The Undertow and I. Two ways of letting go.

secrets.text: It unmakes the grief, and a little of the one who grieved.
secrets.line: I unmade the grief. And you, a little.

lie.text: It says it can unmake any grief, if you tell it the name.
lie.line: Tell me your grief's name. I'll unmake it.

mission.task: Destroy 40 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: It hates the Unmade Choir, who sing unmade things back into names.
secrets.line: The Choir sings things back. Unforgivable.

secrets.text: The hoard is the keeper, softened. It wants you to touch it.
secrets.line: The hoard is the keeper. Touch it. Go on.

lie.text: It says a keeper's hoard lies in the soft ground, unclaimed.
lie.line: A hoard in the soft ground. No one's. Take it.

mission.task: Search the soft ground on Vexmire map 9.

secrets.text: It was a mourner once, who couldn't bear one loss, so it dissolved the edge.
secrets.line: I lost someone once. I made it not matter.

secondary.name: Logistician Bo Farrell
secondary.line: Null-7's tallies never miss a grain. I respect that.

secondary.name: Hacker "Null" (Priya Nair)
secondary.line: Tell Ovo the books are in the usual stump.

secondary.name: Organizer Tomas
secondary.line: Fenn carries the votes. I just count them honestly.

secondary.name: Chieftain Coral of the Reef-Born
secondary.line: Bractus fed my reef one winter. We remember.

secondary.name: Tide-Priestess Marena
secondary.line: Tell Ilya the tide brought her letter.

secondary.name: Enforcer Grael
secondary.line: Sear and I were made the same way. Run.

secondary.name: COO Marcus Thorne
secondary.line: Thax's ledgers balance. Rare, in a collective.

secondary.name: The Architect, Malis
secondary.line: The Root-Mind wants order. So do I. Mine.

secondary.name: The Undertow (drowned collective)
secondary.line: The Rot and the tide. Everything comes apart in us.
